problem_statement: Signup: Make input width consistent across steps We have various steps in signup that show a single input with a button. I'd like to see us make all these inputs have the same max-width. The width of the `site-topic` input seems like a sane place to start — lets make all the other inputs that width.
PASS_TO_PASS: ["<SiteVerticalsSuggestionSearch /> - should pass an exact non-user vertical match to the `onChange` prop", "<SiteVerticalsSuggestionSearch /> - sortSearchResults() - should not sort when no `startsWith` suggestions", "<SiteVerticalsSuggestionSearch /> - sortSearchResults() - should return sorted results with `startsWith` matches at the start and exact match at the end", "<SiteVerticalsSuggestionSearch /> - sortSearchResults() - should omit non-matchess", "<SiteInformation /> - should call `updateStep()` from `handleInputChange()`", "<SiteInformation /> - should call `submitStep()` from `handleSubmit()`", "<SiteVerticalsSuggestionSearch /> - should cancel debounced invocations when the search value is falsey or has fewer chars than `props.charsToTriggerSearch`", "<SiteInformation /> - should update field attributes based on the informationFields array values", "<SiteVerticalsSuggestionSearch /> - should trigger search after > 1 characters and call `onChange` prop"]
